primary_cities_note: Client-provided target list (Form Q15): Melbourne CBD anchor + 23 suburbs/regional cities. Declared primary so validate_selection treats them as primary location silos (v0.4.9 grid contract — primary_cities MUST=target for location-heavy packages). Phase 2 (client-provided mode) validates + enriches with search volume; the final approved grid is written back here post-Phase 2/5.
suburb_source_note: Client supplied a deliberate 23-location list (Q15) skewed to western/northern Melbourne growth corridors (Werribee, Point Cook, Tarneit, Truganina, Hoppers Crossing — high young-family + migrant demand for childcare/aged-care) plus 3 regional cities (Bendigo, Geelong, Warrnambool). Honoured as client-provided. Switch to data-driven if the analyst wants Greater-Melbourne expansion beyond this list.
location_keywords_note: Analyst chose KEEP ALL 23 client suburbs at the Phase 2 checkpoint (2026-07-14). 3 silos x 23 suburbs = 69 location keywords (9 above the original 60 request, accepted as bonus). resolve_location_budget reads location_keywords, so score_keywords selects N=ceil(69/3)=23 = all 23 suburbs.
